source_title: For Year-End Sales Events, Trust Is the New Currency
business_context: Retailers need to improve deal credibility: net trust scores separate verifiable proof from persuasive tactics.
key_message: 2026년 소비자 설문에서 유통사 평판·환불 보장의 신뢰 순점수는 각각 +65%p이나 인플루언서 추천은 +3%p이므로, 판촉 규모 확대보다 검증 가능한 증거를 우선 강화해야 한다.
encoding: x=net trust score (pp); y=ranked factor; teal color=verification/customer proof/persuasion; direct end labels; no numeric x ticks

data_spec.denominator: respondents to factor question (item counts not disclosed; 10,220 survey overall)
data_spec.calculation: % share saying increases trust minus % share saying decreases trust

data_recipe: Compute net pp by factor and identical weight rules
Rank scores; classify factors with a transparent legend
message_conditions: Net trust score not a share of shoppers or actual conversion
No causal inference or per-factor confidence intervals
diff_notes: Topological match to BCG official Exhibit 2: 11 bars, same order and values. Our title, factor short labels, palette shade and footer/legend geometry differ; fonts are open source defaults, not source assets.

training_pair.instruction: Generate a reusable consulting figure supporting: 2026년 소비자 설문에서 유통사 평판·환불 보장의 신뢰 순점수는 각각 +65%p이나 인플루언서 추천은 +3%p이므로, 판촉 규모 확대보다 검증 가능한 증거를 우선 강화해야 한다.
